---
name: Tool bug report
about: Report a reproducible inspection or media-validation problem
labels: bug
---

## Expected and observed result

Which tool failed, and what did you expect? Include the commit and Python version.

## Minimal reproduction

Use a synthetic fixture when possible. Replace all local paths and identifying
values. State the app version and system only if relevant. Commands should show
placeholder paths.

## Sanitized output

Include only the relevant aggregate fields or generic error message. Do not
upload app bundles, extracted vendor code, license material, raw project files,
recordings, captured keys, private logs or credentials.

## Scope of evidence

Was this a static inspection, a mocked test, an actual local tool run or a human
recording/export check? Keep these separate.
